headline: Modi Naturals releases Q2 and H1 financial results
hook: Modi Naturals reports half-year financial results
summary: Modi Naturals has submitted its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the six-month period. These results are now available for review by shareholders and market participants. The data allows investors to assess the company's profitability and operational health for the first half of the fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current financial health.

headline: NSE seeks clarification from Modi Naturals following unusual stock price movement
hook: Unexplained price movement triggers exchange scrutiny
summary: The National Stock Exchange has sought a clarification from Modi Naturals Limited regarding a significant movement in its stock price. The exchange flagged the price action to protect investor interests and ensure timely information flow. Modi Naturals has submitted its official response to the exchange inquiry. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review exchange disclosures for the company's stated reasons behind the market activity.
whats_next: Modi Naturals disclosure release on NSE
why_it_matters: Clarification filing expected to explain recent stock volatility

headline: Modi Naturals Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Rajan Kumar Singh resigns
hook: Key compliance officer exits Modi Naturals
summary: Modi Naturals Limited announced that Rajan Kumar Singh has resigned from his position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 14, 2026. The company has informed the stock exchange about this management change. Routine managerial departures of this nature generally have minimal impact on the operational performance of listed micro-cap companies. Retail investors should note leadership transitions in compliance roles as part of standard corporate governance tracking.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with no direct impact on stock price
